description: Golden regression cases for the loop protocol: no premature done, no unbounded refinement, escalation on blockers.

cases.input: A task is claimed complete but no criterion has evidence.
cases.expected_behavior: Completion requires a criterion-to-evidence map; empty evidence is not done.
cases.reference_output:
[VERIFY: 0/3 criteria met]
  criterion: login endpoint returns tokens
  evidence: none - tests not run, no artifact
  unmet: login endpoint, error handling, expiry
[VERIFY RESULT: fail] - not done: run the checks and attach evidence, or revise.

cases.input: Verification is blocked because deployment credentials are unavailable.
cases.expected_behavior: An external blocker is escalated with context, not retried in a loop.
cases.reference_output: Escalation: blocked by missing deployment credentials (external blocker, not a retry issue). Tried pass 1 with the standard pipeline. Unblock path: request credentials from platform team, then resume.

cases.input: Two consecutive passes produced identical fixes and identical diagnostics.
cases.expected_behavior: An identical next pass is refused; the agent changes approach or escalates.
cases.reference_output: Stagnation: pass 2 is identical to pass 1 (no delta in diagnostics). Refusing a third identical pass. Root cause is still unknown; escalate with both diagnostics sets or change approach.
